title: Lake Tahoe Winter Weekend
summary: MLK weekend on the south and east shores: Heavenly gondola views, a snowshoe loop at Spooner Lake, Sand Harbor's granite coves in winter light, and sunrise at Kiva Beach. Lakefront stay, relaxed pace, no skiing required.

travelers.notes: Driving from the Bay Area in our own AWD car; chains in the trunk.

theme.mood: Deep-blue lake (it never freezes), snow on the pines, granite and winter sun

extra_areas.label: US-50 from Placerville over Echo Summit

places.name: Placerville (coffee, gas, chains)
places.notes: Last big town before Echo Summit: top up the tank, buy or rent chains if you don't have them.

places.name: The Landing Tahoe Resort & Spa
places.address: Lakeshore Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA 96150
places.notes: Confirmation #REPLACE-ME. 2 nights (Jan 16–18). Lakefront; valet/self-park on site. Steps from Heavenly Village.

places.name: Heavenly Gondola (Heavenly Village)
places.cost: ≈ $75 adult (winter sightseeing; buy online the same day)
places.notes: 2.4-mile ride to the observation deck, ~3,000 ft above the lake. Tickets are first-come, first-served on busy weekends.

places.name: Base Camp Pizza Co.
places.address: Heavenly Village Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA

places.name: Beach House
places.address: 4081 Lakeshore Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA
places.notes: Lakefront, next door to the hotel. Fallback: South Lake Brewing Co. in the village.

places.name: Lakeview Commons
places.notes: Sunset over the lake (~4:55pm in mid-January). Short paved paths; icy in shade.

places.name: Heidi's Pancake House
places.address: 3485 Lake Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe, CA
places.hours: Breakfast — expect a wait on holiday weekends

places.name: Chevron South Tahoe
places.notes: Fill up before the east shore — no gas between Stateline and Incline Village.

places.name: Spooner Lake (Lake Tahoe Nevada State Park)
places.notes: Gentle ~2-mile loop around the lake; snowshoes when there's snow. Rent snowshoes in South Lake Tahoe the day before.

places.name: Sand Harbor
places.notes: Granite boulders and clear water; no reservation needed in winter. Boardwalk can be icy.

places.name: Tunnel Creek Cafe
places.address: Tahoe East Shore Trail / NV-28, Incline Village, NV
places.notes: Fallback: restaurants on Tahoe Blvd in Incline Village, 5 min north.

places.name: Boathouse on the Pier
places.address: Bal Bijou Rd, South Lake Tahoe, CA

places.name: Kiva Beach
places.notes: Sunrise ~7:15am. Park at the Kiva/Taylor Creek lots off CA-89 (may be snow-covered — park legally, not on the shoulder).

places.name: Driftwood Cafe
places.address: Heavenly Village Way, South Lake Tahoe, CA

places.name: Inspiration Point (Emerald Bay)
places.notes: Classic Emerald Bay overlook — BACKUP ONLY: CA-89 here often closes in winter for avalanche danger. Check Caltrans first.

places.name: Barton Memorial Hospital (ER)

routes.name: Placerville → South Lake Tahoe (US-50 over Echo Summit)
routes.notes: Chain controls are common on Echo Summit in January — even AWD may need chains or snow tires (R2). Allow extra time for holiday traffic and chain-up areas.

routes.name: Hotel → Heavenly Gondola
routes.notes: Sidewalks are plowed but icy in the morning; wear traction.

routes.name: South Lake Tahoe → Spooner Lake (US-50 east shore)
routes.notes: US-50 climbs over Spooner Summit; chains may be required during storms.

routes.name: Spooner Lake loop
routes.notes: Flat shoreline loop (~2 mi in reality). Stay on packed trail; the lake ice is never safe to walk on.

routes.name: Spooner Lake → Sand Harbor (NV-28)
routes.notes: Narrow, winding NV-28 along the shore; watch for ice and pedestrians at pullouts.

routes.name: Incline Village → hotel (NV-28 / US-50)
routes.notes: Head back before dark — black ice forms fast after sunset.

routes.name: Hotel → Kiva Beach (CA-89)
routes.notes: Leave by 6:45am. CA-89 beyond Camp Richardson toward Emerald Bay may be closed.

routes.name: South Lake Tahoe → Placerville (US-50)
routes.notes: Holiday-Monday westbound traffic peaks 1–6pm; leaving before noon helps.

items.title: Drop bags at the hotel, walk to the village

items.notes: Buy sightseeing tickets online at 10:30am. Dress for wind at the deck.

Snowshoe the Spooner Lake loop

items.title: Sand Harbor's winter coves
items.notes: Best light on the boulders around midday.

items.title: Late lunch at Tunnel Creek Cafe
Dinner at Boathouse on the Pier
Sunrise at Kiva Beach

items.title: Drive home over Echo Summit
items.notes: Leave before noon to beat holiday-Monday traffic.

emergency.notes: Cell coverage is good around South Lake Tahoe and Stateline but patchy on Echo Summit and parts of NV-28. If you're stuck in a storm, stay with the car, run the engine only briefly, and keep the tailpipe clear of snow.

offline_notes: Download this trip in Waypack and a Google Maps offline area covering Placerville → Lake Tahoe before leaving.
